title: NFT Factory
tagline: Create and deploy NFT collections on Polygon (or other chains) via Covalent NFT Collection Dashboard
description: NFT Factory allows users to create and deploy ERC-721 NFT collections on Polygon (or other chains) via the Covalent NFT Collection Dashboard. It interacts with the smart contracts of 3rd party marketplaces like Opensea or Looksrare to list or sell the NFTs.........................NFT Factory allows users to create and deploy ERC-721 NFT collections on Polygon (or other chains) via the Covalent NFT Collection Dashboard. It interacts with the smart contracts of 3rd party marketplaces like Opensea or Looksrare to list or sell the NFTs.
how_its_made: The project is built using React.js and solidity. NFT Factory allows users to create and deploy ERC-721 NFT collections on Polygon (or other chains) via the Covalent NFT Collection Dashboard. It interacts with the smart contracts of 3rd party marketplaces like Opensea or Looksrare to list or sell the NFTs
